I don't have access to a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or any tools containing BAA documentation to retrieve specific data residency provisions. To provide you with accurate information citing evidence, I would need you to either:

1. Share the specific BAA document or relevant sections
2. Provide access to a tool or database containing the BAA text
3. Clarify which BAA you're referring to (as they vary by organization)

Once you provide the source material, I can extract the exact data residency language and cite it appropriately.
